how: round 4, built on version B: the plate is ONE lavender disc (its outline one circle, centre (21.78, 680.22) r 208.6, fitted to every boundary pixel no bubble covers) lit by its own light: the basin, the lip, the navy groove and the ridge's dark underside as one radial profile, the ridge's lit top and the outer surface each one gradient across the plate measured away from the bubbles, a 1 px dark outline along the whole arc; the three bubbles' soft cast shadows as one separate layer under one light (offset, softness and strength fitted together, strength capped at 0.42), the necks' shadows likewise; navy necks from under each bubble's rim down into the groove with flared feet; three raised cables, each starting under the rim of its button (info, pause, tools); the bubbles and small buttons composed on top without the tray discs their sprites carry
changed: notes 'lines reaching the 3 buttons is not there' and 'the background behind the 3 buttons should be a shade that's not following the 3 big buttons': the three cables now start under the rims of the info, pause and tools buttons (B began them 3..5 px lower, under a light halo disc each small button carried; the halos are gone); the three navy necks now run from under each mode bubble's rim into the groove with the art's flared feet (B's buildings neck stopped 1.6 px short of the groove, its golfers neck 1.6 px under the rim); the plate's outline is one circle instead of three circles round the bubbles, and its surface is one plate lit by its own light (gradients measured only away from the bubbles), with the bubbles' shadows a separate soft layer cast by one light
